opening.argument: The title calls FTX a “cash grab,” and the narration describes conduct at Alameda as “skullduggery” while placing FTT in a “scam token world.” These are criticisms of FTX, Alameda Research, and related cryptocurrency activity, not an invitation to invest. The presentation offers no viewer action, payment destination, sign-up request, or promised financial benefit. Its claims concern alleged misconduct; they do not ask the viewer for money or personal data.
